posts.title: Tarehe tano kwa ploti

lines.text: Brayo, leo ni tarehe tano na mlango ulikuwa wazi.
Boss, subiri kidogo, kuna transaction inaingia saa hii.
Transaction gani na umelala tangu asubuhi?
Sasha, mbona unaharibia msee wa mtaa connection?
Mimi nataka Wi-Fi irudi, lipa Landlord kwanza.
Hiyo router nabeba sasa hivi, transaction ikikosa ninaweka kufuli kubwa hapa!

posts.caption:
Tarehe tano ikifika, kila mtu kwa ploti anageuka detective.

Keja yenu Landlord anagonga mlango saa ngapi?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Make Brayo blame Safaricom's network for the failed rent transaction instead of arguing.

posts.title: Mvua na fare kwa matatu

lines.text: Niko stage bana, five minutes nifike town.
Kevo, tuko Nyayo Stadium kwa jam na konda amepandisha fare!
Mwambie niko na hamsini pekee, kwani mvua inaongeza petroli?
Konda anasema mwenye hana mia mbili ashuke atembee kwa hii mvua.
Nishuke nitembee kwa mvua na nina hamsini pekee mfukoni?
Bahati yako niko na mwavuli kwa bag, nitumie hamsini kwa Till!

posts.caption:
Mvua ikianza Nairobi fare inapanda kabla hata matone ifike chini.

Ushawahi rushwa nje ya matatu juu ya fare kupanda?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Have Kevo claim he is actually in a chopper hovering above the jam to make the lie worse.

posts.title: Fare ya interview

lines.text: Mathe, nitumie mia mbili ya fare niende interview kesho.
Interview ya nini na ulisomea computer miaka minne?
Hii ni entry-level, wanataka tu mtu anajua kutumia mouse.
Nimeona kwa WhatsApp hiyo kazi inataka miaka tano ya experience.
Mathe, WhatsApp groups zako zinajua hadi kazi za watu?
Zinajua pia mtoto wangu hana fare lakini ako na bundles.

posts.caption:
Hakuna mtu anajua facts za dunia kama Mathe akiwa kwa WhatsApp.

Mathe wako ashawahi kukupata na excuse gani safi?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Mathe calling out the exact bundles he burned watching TikTok lives all night would give the burn an extra sting.
